data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: How can I keep my kid entertained when I'm not home? ASSISTANT:

There are many ways to keep your kid entertained when you’re not home. Here are some ideas: 
- Buy them age-appropriate toys and games that they can play with. 
- Get them a subscription to an educational magazine. 
- Show them age-appropriate videos on YouTube. 
- Make sure they have access to a device with age-appropriate apps.
- Schedule out fun activities with friends. 
- Send them age-appropriate books to read. 
- Buy them a DIY art and craft kit.
